text: Look at what at home catches your eye most: clutter on the desk, some broken thing, dusty windowsills, a dripping faucet in the bathroom... Choose one thing and remove/fix it today. It seems like a trifle, but ordering the external space simultaneously, in some magical way, also orders your internal space. After eliminating the “stress point,” relief and quiet joy often come. And besides, this is how an important life support is formed: you are responsible and know how to bring order into your world.
